verdict.rationale: Grok is a conversational product. The docs show natural-language chat that takes real actions through connectors: creating Salesforce records from chat, sending Teams messages, and managing Drive files. They also show hands-free voice and delegating work to Grok Bot. Hands-on users report Grok intuits intent without micromanagement, though one report says Grok 4 had trouble with agentic tool calling. Missing for 10: evidence that account and workspace administration (e.g., billing, which is handled on the website) can be done by natural language, and consistent independent confirmation that tool calling is reliable.
